title: Authorized fulfillment charge assessment inclusion
purpose: Prove that one exact FOOD-005J payable-assessment version, already validated against one exact FOOD-005E physical-order version, contains exactly one canonical FOOD-005P adjustment rederived from one trusted exact FOOD-005O authorized fulfillment charge candidate.
whyNow: FOOD-005O establishes exact manual-fulfillment charge authority.
FOOD-005P deterministically projects that authority into FOOD-005J direction/reference/money/sourceReference shape.
FOOD-005J validates an exact payable-assessment version against an exact FOOD-005E physical-order version.
The next narrow prerequisite is therefore proof that the exact canonical FOOD-005P adjustment is actually present in one exact FOOD-005J assessment.

contract.authorizedSource: Consume one trusted exact FOOD-005O candidate and rederive FOOD-005P internally. Never trust a caller-supplied adjustment as the authority.
contract.orderValidation: Validate the supplied exact FOOD-005E physical-order version and require its ID/version to equal the FOOD-005O candidate order identity.
contract.assessmentValidation: Use canonical FOOD-005J validation against the exact FOOD-005E order before inspecting adjustments.
contract.cardinality: Exactly one exact canonical projected adjustment must be present. Missing or multiple matches fail closed.
contract.zeroFee: A required manual-approval path with zero approved fee still requires the exact explicit zero-valued FOOD-005P adjustment.
contract.result: Return immutable inclusion evidence identifying the exact order, exact payable assessment and exact matching canonical adjustment.
contract.selection: The caller explicitly supplies the exact assessment version. FOOD-005Q does not choose latest/current/usable assessment.

invariants: assessment inclusion evidence != payable assessment creation
assessment inclusion evidence != payable assessment revision
same money without exact canonical provenance is not inclusion
same provenance with wrong money is not inclusion
credit direction is never equivalent to the required charge
historical inclusion evidence cannot revive a cancelled order or grant operational authority
deferred: atomic inventory/slot persistence and race protection

future.policyComposition: A later readiness composition may require FOOD-005Q inclusion evidence only when exact FOOD-005N policy says manual approval is required; a not-required path should not invent FOOD-005O/Q evidence.
future.assessmentSelection: A separate trusted seam must choose which exact FOOD-005J assessment version is usable/current.
future.readiness: FOOD-005Q may become one prerequisite of future checkout/payment readiness but never establishes readiness by itself.
future.reservation: Authoritative atomic inventory/slot reservation remains an independent prerequisite.
